description: This file contains unit tests for the apiClient module, which is a configured Axios instance used for making HTTP requests. The tests verify configuration details, interceptor registration, header modification based on localStorage tokens, and mocked responses for GET and POST requests.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Resets modules and mocks localStorage before each test to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: afterAll
methods.description: Restores environment variables after all tests.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Multiple test cases verifying different aspects of apiClient configuration and behavior.
